Regular Meeting City Council and Successor Agency to the Community Development Commission
AGENDA
la puente Regular Meeting City Council and Successor Agency to the Community Development Commission
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
MARCH 27, 2012
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL MEMBERS/AGENCY MEMBERS: House, Mendoza, Holloway, Argudo, Solis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION BY CHIEF LOPEZ FROM REGION 2 ON AB 109
AB 109 PowerPoint Presentation

Military Banner-Elias Romero
PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES OF RECOGNITION FOR LA PUENTE HIGH SCHOOL WRESTLING TEAMS
Certificates Wresting Teams
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL/AGENCY MEETING
Mayor Solis recessed the City Council/Agency meeting at 8:00 p.m.
RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL/AGENCY MEETING
PRESENTATION OF A PROCLAMATION DECLARING APRIL AS FAIR HOUSING MONTH
Proclamation-Fair Housing Month
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
RECESS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETING
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETINGS OF DECEMBER 13, 2011 AND MARCH 13, 2012
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meetings of December 13, 2011 and March 13, 2012.
CC.A-1.a Minutes 12 13 11 CC
CC.A-1.b Minutes 03-13-2011 CC
A-2
READ APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE JOINT SPECIAL MEETING OF JANUARY 3, 2012
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Joint Special Meeting of January 3, 2012.
CC.A-2 Minutes 01 03 12 Special Joint CC&PC Mtg
A-3
READ APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETINGS OF JANUARY 5, 2012, JANUARY 11, 2012 AND MARCH 13, 2012
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Special Meetings of January 5, 2012, January 11, 2012 and March 13, 2012.

CC.A-3.b Minutes 01 11 12 Special Mtg.
CC.A-3.c Minutes 03-13-2011 CC special
B.
PUBLIC HEARING BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1316 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2011-12
The City Council adopted the Resolution No. 12-5001 approving Warrant Register No. 1316.
CC.D-1 CITY WR#1316
D-2
APPROVAL OF THE TREASURER’S/FINANCIAL REPORT FOR JANUARY 31, 2012
The City Council received and filed the Monthly Treasurer’s/Financial Reports for January 31, 2012.
CC.D-2 Fin Financial Report 1-31-12
CC.D-2 Attachments A-F
D-3
APPROVAL OF THE TREASURER’S/FINANCIAL REPORT FOR FEBRUARY 29, 2012
The City Council received and filed the Monthly Treasurer’s/Financial Reports for February 29, 2012.
CC.D-3 Fin Financial Report 2-29-12
CC.D-3 Attachments A-F
D-4
APPROVAL OF AN EXTENSION OF THE CONTRACT WITH VASQUEZ AND COMPANY LLP FOR AUDITING SERVICES FOR THREE ADDITIONAL FISCAL YEARS BEGINNING WITH FISCAL YEAR 2011-2012
The City Council approved the proposals provided by Vasquez and Company LLP, Inc. and authorized the City Manager to sign the engagement letter for three additional fiscal years of auditing services beginning with fiscal year ending June 30, 2012.
CC.D-4 Fin Auditing Services Report
CC.D-4 Fin Auditing Services - Attachment A
CC.D-4 Fin Auditing Services - Attachment B
CC.D-4 Fin Auditing Services - Attachment C
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING A LEASE WITH OPTION TO PURCHASE AND ACQUISITION FUND AGREEMENT IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $270,000.00, BETWEEN THE CITY AND MUNICIPAL FINANCE CORPORATION, FOR REPLACEMENT OF THE CITY’S HVAC SYSTEM, AND AUTHORIZING CERTAIN ACTIONS IN CONNECTION THEREWITH
The City Council approved Resolution No. 12-5002 authorizing the execution and delivery of a lease with option to purchase and acquisition fund agreement, and authorizing certain actions in connection therewith.
CC.D-5 HVAC Lease Option Report
CC.D-5 HVAC Lease Option - Attachment A
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A PARK USE AGREEMENT FOR THE AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY FOR THE RELAY FOR LIFE EVENT
The City Council approved the Park Use Agreement to Permit the use of La Puente Park for the American Cancer Society Relay for Life event.
CC.D-6 AGMT-Relay for Life
CC.D-6 AGMT-Relay for Life-Attach
D-7
ADOPT AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AMENDING SECTION 2.13 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO EXCEPTIONS TO THE CIVIL SERVICE SYSTEM
The City Council adopted Ordinance No. 12-921 of the City of La Puente, amending Section 2.13 of the La Puente Municipal Code relating to exceptions of the Civil Service System.
CC.D-7 HR Staff Report CivilService Ordinance
CC.D-7 HR Report Civil Service Ordinance-AttachmentA(Ordinance)
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL - None.

CDC.A-1 Minutes 12 13 11 CDC
A-2
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF MARCH 13, 2012
It is recommended that the Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of March 13, 2012.
SA.A-2 Minutes 03-13-2011 SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS - None.
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR - None.
E.

E-1
CONFIRMATION OF MAYOR'S APPOINTMENTS TO THE OVERSIGHT BOARD OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the draft resolution confirming the Mayor's appointments to the Oversight Board pursuant to Health and Safety Code Section 34179(a).
SA.E-1 Mayor Appointment to Oversight Board Report
SA.E-1 Resolution Appointing Oversight Board
RECESS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY AND RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL
RECESS CITY COUNCIL INTO CLOSED SESSION

THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE 54957.6(f) TO CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS. AGENCY DESIGNATED REPRESENTATIVES: BRET M. PLUMLEE, CITY MANAGER; WARD KOMERS, DIRECTOR OF ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES; AND IRMA RODRIGUEZ-MOISA, COUNSEL. EMPLOYEE ORGANIZATIONS: CEA AND SEIU
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION
AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS - None.
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
